messages.subject: modindices - strange values
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

i get very strange modificationindices. Here is my example:

############################################################
require("lavaan")

dep.cov.matrix <- structure(c(0.103684, 0.0812406, 0.06324724, 0.05863137, 0.051673272, 
                              0.048486438, 0.0812406, 0.09, 0.0601818, 0.0584685, 0.0487959, 
                              0.0502524, 0.06324724, 0.0601818, 0.103684, 0.0815143, 0.064791874, 
                              0.058623642, 0.05863137, 0.0584685, 0.0815143, 0.093025, 0.05918952, 
                              0.05888025, 0.051673272, 0.0487959, 0.064791874, 0.05918952, 
                              0.096721, 0.078604317, 0.048486438, 0.0502524, 0.058623642, 0.05888025, 
                              0.078604317, 0.088209), .Dim = c(6L, 6L),
                            .Dimnames = list(c("dep1.t1", "dep2.t1", "dep1.t2", "dep2.t2", "dep1.t3", "dep2.t3"), c("dep1.t1", "dep2.t1", "dep1.t2", "dep2.t2", "dep1.t3", "dep2.t3")))

dep.means <- c(0.314, 0.281, 0.280, 0.259, 0.286, 0.260)



#### 1. Latent State Model 
ls.model.1 <- 'state1  =~ dep1.t1 + dep2.t1
               state2  =~ dep1.t2 + dep2.t2
               state3  =~ dep1.t3 + dep2.t3'

ls.model.1.fit <- cfa(ls.model.1, 
                      sample.cov = dep.cov.matrix, 
                      sample.mean = dep.means,
                      sample.cov.rescale = FALSE, 
                      sample.nobs = 620,
                      meanstructure = TRUE)

summary(ls.model.1.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)


modind <- modindices(ls.model.1.fit)

#sorted by MI
modind[order(modind$mi, decreasing = TRUE),]
############################################################

Here are the five bigges mi-values:

       lhs op     rhs       mi          epc      sepc.lv      sepc.all      sepc.nox
1  dep1.t3 ~~ dep2.t3 9533.710  3736579.026  3736579.026  40453614.150  40453614.150
2  dep1.t2 ~~ dep2.t2 3710.751 -2691804.107 -2691804.107 -27408656.876 -27408656.876
3  dep1.t2 ~~ dep2.t3   22.770       -0.005       -0.005        -0.056        -0.056
4  dep1.t2 ~~ dep1.t3   22.475        0.006        0.006         0.055         0.055
5  dep2.t1 ~~ dep2.t3   17.469        0.004        0.004         0.045         0.045

The mi-values in the first and second row are way to high? The second row (dep1.t2 ~~ dep2.t2) does not make any sense, because these two indicators belong to the same latent variable.

Has anybody a idea why i get these values? Thank you for your help!
